title: QCTSM capability catalog snapshot v1
description: A complete replacement snapshot for one source. Original payload objects are retained without field rewriting.

revision.description: An opaque caller-owned revision. Reusing a revision with different content is invalid.

expected_revision.description: Optional optimistic concurrency precondition. A string must match the current source revision. Null requires the source not to exist. Omission replaces without a revision precondition.

force_rebuild.description: Recompute available records for the active embedding profile while retaining existing compatible vectors until replacements are published. Does not bypass revision preconditions.

record_id.description: Unique within source_id. Omission or an empty value selects a canonical content hash.

capability_id.description: Groups a definition and its invocation examples. Omission permits inference from payload identifiers.

rawInvocation.title: Unwrapped invocation JSON
rawInvocation.description: A record with no payload field is imported as an example. Use an envelope when the original JSON itself has a payload field.
